election.source_note: Bilt Rewards Card Offer Terms, last updated October 27, 2026 (bilt.com/terms/bilt-card-offer-terms), read by engineering on 2026-11-15 for ENG-02B; Argon to confirm against the published text. Rewards Option for accounts opened before 2027, until their first Card Anniversary Date on or after January 1, 2027: selectable in the app, a change takes effect on the first day of the next Billing Cycle. From that anniversary it continues only under a Legacy Election. Not offered to accounts opened on or after January 1, 2027. Card Anniversary Date: one year after the first day of the first Billing Cycle that begins after the Account Open Date, then the same day each year. No published figure says how long after opening that billing cycle begins, so opened_on alone does not place the anniversary: record anniversary_on (as the Bilt app shows it) or first_billing_cycle_on on the card holding (Step 04B removed the former 62-day engineering allowance).
